<!-- Thanks for contributing to TATAR-Kuber! -->

## What & why

Describe the change and the motivation. Link related issues (e.g. `Closes #12`).

## Type

- [ ] New scanner adapter
- [ ] Canonical control / mapping change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Docs / tests

## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./...` is green
- [ ] `gofmt` and `go vet ./...` are clean
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_registry.py` passes (if the registry changed)
- [ ] Canonical `TATAR-*` IDs were not reused or renumbered
- [ ] Added/updated tests and fixtures where relevant

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know (trade-offs, follow-ups, screenshots).
